title: Étale proper base change for module coefficients
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, let $f:X\to Y$ be proper, let
$g:Y'\to Y$ be arbitrary, and let $f',g'$ be the base changes as in
[def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. Write
$\mathrm{For}:D^+(T_{\Et},\Lambda)\to D^+(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z)$ for the
forgetful functor. For every $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ there is a
canonical identification

$$
\mathrm{For}\bigl(\Ex^{\Lambda}_{\square,K}\bigr)=\Ex^{\mathbf Z}_{\square,\mathrm{For}K}
$$

under the isomorphisms $\mathrm{For}\,g^{-1}=g^{-1}\mathrm{For}$,
$\mathrm{For}\,Rf_*\cong Rf_*\mathrm{For}$ (and likewise for $f',g'$) of
[det-pbc-conventions-module-cohomology]. Consequently, if the cohomology
sheaves of $\mathrm{For}K$ are torsion, then
$\Ex^{\Lambda}_{\square,K}:g^{-1}Rf_*K\to Rf'_*g'^{-1}K$ is an isomorphism in
$D^+(Y'_{\Et},\Lambda)$.

proof.text: Step 1 (compatibility after forgetting coefficients). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients] to the given Cartesian square and $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$; here $D^+(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z)$ is the bounded below derived category of abelian sheaves, $\Mod(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z)=\Ab(T_{\Et})$, and $\Ex^\Lambda_{\square,K}$ is the derived exchange morphism formed with the $\Lambda$-linear adjunctions, as in clause (3) of that lemma. Its clause (1) gives the inverse-image identifications $\mathrm{For}\circ u^{-1}=u^{-1}\circ\mathrm{For}$ for $u\in\{f,f',g,g'\}$ named in the item. Its clause (2) gives, for $u\in\{f,f'\}$, the comparison $\mathrm{For}(Ru_*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru_*(\mathrm{For}K)$; this is the canonical isomorphism of clause (3) of [det-pbc-conventions-module-cohomology] named in the item: choosing a bounded below complex $I^\bullet$ of injective $\Lambda$-module sheaves with $K\simeq I^\bullet$, both maps are $\mathrm{For}(Ru_*K)=u_*\mathrm{For}I^\bullet\to Ru_*(\mathrm{For}I^\bullet)=Ru_*(\mathrm{For}K)$, the map from the underived to the derived direct image (Stacks Lemma 0D6J (3)), and it is an isomorphism because the terms $\mathrm{For}I^m$ are $u_*$-acyclic by clause (1) of [det-pbc-conventions-module-cohomology]. Under these comparisons, clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients] identifies $\mathrm{For}(\Ex^\Lambda_{\square,K})$ with $\Ex^{\mathbf Z}_{\square,\mathrm{For}K}$, which is the claimed identification. The lemma requires neither properness nor torsion, so it applies to every $K$ here.

source.place: Lemma 0D6J (lemma-modules-abelian-unbounded), part (3), and Remark 07A7 (remark-base-change); compatibility is the statement of the cited existing node

proof.text: Step 2 (torsion consequence). Suppose that the cohomology sheaves of $\mathrm{For}K$ are torsion. Exactness of $\mathrm{For}$ and its cohomology comparison, stated in [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients], ensure that $\mathrm{For}K$ is bounded below. The square is Cartesian and $f$ is proper, so [thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below] applied to $\mathrm{For}K$ makes $\Ex^{\mathbf Z}_{\square,\mathrm{For}K}$ an isomorphism. The final equivalence in [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients] then gives that $\Ex^\Lambda_{\square,K}$ is an isomorphism in $D^+(Y'_{\Et},\Lambda)$.
